description: Throw away the unpublished draft on a PUBLISHED form, so it goes back to exactly what is live. The live form is untouched and no respondent sees anything change. Use it to abandon an edit in progress. Nothing staged means nothing to do. Needs forms:write.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

name: fillo_discard_changes
title: Discard a form's staged changes
